characters.name: 2B

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 Is good, but the user can hold off upgrading it as you’ll be using her with Max HP buffers for the most part anyways.

Skill 2 is where you’ll be getting your enormous ATK Pool from

Burst is where you’ll be hitting HARD

characters.summary: 2B is a decent DPS that requires high investments to deal respectable damage. 2B gains massive attack and HP buffs from her passive in exchange for much lower normal attack values. 2B usually gets targetted in Solo raids due to her high attack and HP if the boss has selective targetting, effectively making her a tank. half of her damage is tied to her burst as she has decent burst damage values while having very high attack.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign C / Boss A / PvP B based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: A2

skillInvestment.notes: All skills pretty much synergize with each other, and hold almost equal value.

characters.summary: Niche DPS that can perform decently against bosses with multiple parts. A2's Rocket Launcher has a bigger radius than normal, which makes her a viable campaign Nikke when raised well. A2's burst requires her to be paired with a good consistent healer or her DPS plummets. Does unimpressive damage against bosses without parts. This Nikke shows very strong early-mid game potential in campaign clearing and/or element strong stages, assume S tier until high deficit if fully raised, which is around 30%~ CP difference. This applies to most Commanders.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign A / Boss B / PvP B based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Ada

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is where a lot of her power comes from, the supportive buffs she gives to other B3 units, especially fellow true damage dealers.

Skill 2 is her main, and practically only source of DPS.

While her burst is terrible, the buffs it provides for her grenades are still valuable. It can be increased further than the minimum to get a bit more damage out of them, as well as for PvP purposes.

characters.summary: SSR Electric Attacker from Abnormal using RL.

characters.name: Ade

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 and Burst give too little to invest to.

Skill 2 Needs to be at level 5 to even proc her Skill 1 outside of full burst. Most of the time, the Player will be in Full burst Anyways. Upgrade to level 5 if wanted

characters.summary: Used mostly against content that needs cleanse. Not viable anywhere else
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Ade: Agent Bunny

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is where part of her generalist buff comes from, and is prioritized over S2, to work with more units.

Skill 2 gives pierce damage to the team, and gives her personal ATK. Unless she is your only unit that can buff pierce damage, this can be left lower.

Burst is where her biggest buff comes through. It's a must max, it's one of the strongest buffs for the party in a single skill.

characters.summary: Ade: Agent Bunny is a B2 support with powerful buffs that any ally can make use of. While she doesn't have any other utility, offense is usually the best defense as well.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign S / Boss S / PvP C based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Admi

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 requires getting hit 20 times to proc passive which is horrible.

Burst not too highly rated as reload speed slightly falls off late game if over/invested; also needs to be with Scarlet or Modernia to benefit greatly

characters.summary: Strong reload speed buffer, pairs very well with Scarlet and/or Alice to help them reach 100% reload speed. Also a decent charge support, or last bullet support with Privaty.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss C / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Aigis
characters.summary: SR Iron Supporter from Abnormal using SMG.

characters.name: Alice

skillInvestment.notes:
Very investment hungry unit, but pays off in the late game.

Burst is main priority followed by skill 1.

Skill 2 can be raised just for HP leech comfort.

Does not perform too well at lower investment levels, only invest when you plan to commit. Huge single target damage. Need to max out skill 1 and burst with 2x overload rolls to reach 100% charge speed and achieve her maximum potential.

characters.summary: Very strong self DPS buffs on burst that scales extremely well with reload speed and charge speed buffs. Good charge shot support. Good AoE from pierce. Must be kept above 80% HP for pierce, but this is easily achievable thanks to her passive. Alice requires high skill investments in her skill 1 and burst to be good (S Tier), and very strict overload requiremets (8%~ Charge speed, 2-3+ rolls of max ammo, and elemental damage for solo raids/bosses)
weaknesses: Demands high skill book and manual resource investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign A / Boss S / PvP A based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Alice: Wonderland Bunny

skillInvestment.notes:
Has enough healing to sustain most teams with low investments

However her skill 2 needs a bit more investment as her partial reload is a strong buff for SG teams, and the skill values starts very low. Level as needed

characters.summary: Alice: Wonderland Bunny is usually reserved for shotgun teams as she reduces the RNG of tove teams, but can work outside that team archetype as she provides strong passive healing and doesn't directly compete with her burst slot (Burst I) as she has a trait that allows the team to re-enter burst 1 when she bursts, effectively making her a "burst 0" Nikke. unfortunately she offers relatively weak offensive buffs in the form of max ammo capacity (additive) and partial mag reloads.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign C / Boss C / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.summary: SR Wind Defender from Elysion using RL.

characters.name: Anchor: Innocent Maid

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 provides distributed damage, the buff her team archetype wants the most

Skill 2 provides a good amount of ATK and reload speed, useful for teams that have long reload times

Burst provides overhealing and some ATK, since Burst mats are a bit scarce, this can be left at level 7 as the buffs aren’t too impactful

characters.summary: Little use if not paired with Mast: Romantic Maid. Her role is to prevent Mast: Romantic Maid from stunning herself after she reaches full drunken stacks. She provides strong healing, slightly below Blancs healing (one of the strongest healers) during burst. When paired with Mast: Romantic Maid, has the strongest buffing potential for Nikkes that mostly deal distributed damage.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign S / Boss S / PvP S based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Anis
characters.summary: Best SR B2 for auto play. Superb burst energy generarion. Good kit and strong burst. Falls off due to lower SR base stats.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP A based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Anis: Sparkling Summer

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 Is where her buffs for the team lie. Really great buffs with good scaling when paired with electric teams

Skill 2 Is the meat of her damage. Works well in all content and probably the strongest skill 1/2 in the game.

Burst can stay at level 4 until you have enough skill mats to level it up to 9 as that is when Anis is able to have 1 ammo on her burst without Privaty. Leveling the burst incrementally gives little benefit in normal scenarios.

characters.summary: Does great in all forms of content. She has very strong personal damage and buffs for electric code teams. Anis: Sparkling Summer has a big damage breakpoint at burst level 9. Anis burst will reduce her capcity to 1 instead of 2, which is extremely important for PvP and boss battles. Her skill 1 also provides exponential DPS gains when paired with electric coded units via almost instant reload speed with resilience cube
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign S / Boss S / PvP S based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Anis: Star

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 improves the cooldown, attack activation on her weapon, the burst generation and the ATK buff when she is the solo B1. Even though all of her skills are important, because the cooldown reduction is on S1, it has slightly more priority.

Skill 2 is where her team buff comes from, and gives her even more personal damage if she is the sole B1. Since this big buff is what sets her apart from other cooldown units, it’s still very important to level

Burst boosts her DPS to be some of the highest in the game. For a B1 unit to have this much DPS is unreal, and that’s before considering everything else she does from her other skills.

characters.summary: SSR Electric Defender from Tetra using RL.

characters.name: Anne: Miracle Fairy

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 doesn’t heal a great amount, but does help a tad bit for survivability.

Burst is Amazing in SW / Maxwell teams. Still good outside SW comp but 60s CD is simply too long sometimes. Great burst in Arena.

characters.summary: Anne Miracle fairy provides a strong team attack buff and one time resurrection at the cost of being a 60s burst cooldown Nikke. Hard to find a team for her in any content except for PvP as most fights end in 1 full burst. Her kit is very strong in PvP as it allows for comfortable one shot burst skill rotations while also providing emergency resurrections and above average burst generation.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss C / PvP A based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Arcana

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 has similar massive buffs to Skill 2 provides buffs, with slight less priority.

Skill 2 provied stronger buffs than Skill 1 and increases the provided cooldown reduction. Higher Priority.

Burst is the weakest part of her kit and can be kept low, as the way it works is the same regardless of its level.

characters.summary: IMPORTANT: Her tier is based on the pairing with Isabel. On her own she is basically unusable.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss S / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Arcana: Fortune Mate

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 contains her caster ATK buff and her Normal Attack Damage buff. Due to the fact that the shotgun team already has both ToveT and DrakeT giving away a ton of ATK, as well as the low uptime on max stack Normal Attack Damage multiplier, it can be left at 7 to save on resources.

Skill 2 is where the Attack Damage buff to allies comes from. While the other buffs to self that come from this skill are quite minimal, the Attack Damage buff to allies make it a must max.

Burst is where a lot of her personal power comes from, since it enables so much of her kit. It can be maxed out eventually to give her higher personal DPS, especially vs Fire-weak content.

characters.summary: SSR Fire Attacker from Elysion using SG.

characters.name: Aria

skillInvestment.notes: Aria is mostly used for shield one shot protection. Her skills don’t provide much increased DPS to be worth investing into. Leveling burst won’t toughen her shield durability enough to make a difference; it is already great for its purpose as is at burst level 1

characters.summary: A decent shielder and DPS with good crit support. Notable for enabling you to survive longer against Modernia.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Ark Ranger Black

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 gives her a huge ATK buff and an easy to get Sustained Damage buff.

Skill 2 provides her a small Sustained Damage effect and a bigger Sustained Damage buff. While the buff from S2 is greater than the one from S1, since all three abilities give Black a ton of Sustained Damage, especially Burst, S2 has a lower recommendation. Can be maxed if using sSakura alongside Black, as her low self-buffing means she appreciates a higher buff power.

Burst is where a ton of her combat ability comes from, especially in stages and bosses that lack parts. The huge Sustained Damage against any high HP enemy and an even bigger Sustained Damage buff results in a lot of damage potential.

characters.summary: SSR Wind Attacker from Tetra using AR.

characters.name: Asuka

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is able to give herself a massive attack boost, while providing shield breaking utility.

Skill 2 has a team buff that is rare for Nikkes, and that is core damage boost. which means no other buffs would dilute its value except for more of itself

Burst is extremely important for her self DPS, as it increases her pierce duration (15s at level 1, 20s at level 4, 25s at level 7), hit rate for guaranteed core hits, and ATK Damage ▲

characters.summary: Extremely strong DPS potential via insane self-buffs, with her attack buff being permanent due to her burst being able to proc it.
weaknesses: Demands high skill book and manual resource investment

characters.name: Asuka: WILLE

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is pretty much where all of her non-burst damage resides, upgrade ASAP.

Skill 2 and her burst provide decent damage boosts but is not worth spending gold mats unless you have a lot around.

characters.summary: Asuka: Wille has comparable DPS to Scarlet: Black Shadow. Contrary to first impressions, she does not need to be paired Rei (Tentative Name) to function properly. Top tier bossing Nikke with good Campaign clearing potential. (P.S. This is a DPS MG Nikke, they require 60 FPS to deal their expected damage. for reference, playing at 30 fps effectively halves their DPS)
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign B / Boss S / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

Skill 2 provides Anis: Star with a great buff that stacks additively with Anis: Star’s buffs, making it her most important skill.

Burst does little on its own, its main purpose is to activate Skill 2 for Anis: Star.

skillInvestment.notes: Skill 1, 2 and Burst can comfortably be raised to level 4/5 as they all do provide decent improvement towards survivability and damage, but not justifiable enough to upgrade much further.

characters.summary: One of the top supports in PvE when paired with Noir, also does pretty good in PvP when giving invul to attackers that can solo wipe enemies.

characters.name: Blanc

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is a rather weak shield, not worth investing too much skill books in.

Skill 2 is where some of her healing comes from, great in boss fights.

Burst is where her kit becomes pretty insane. Damage taken debuff + more healing. Very worth to upgrade to higher levels.

characters.summary: Blanc is a duo Nikke, she requires either Noir or Rouge to utilize her kit efficiently. Blanc has strong and unique offensive buffs, where she increases the damage taken by target raptures, which is one of the more rare damage modifiers in the game (direct damage multiplier in almost all teams). Despite having stronger duo options available (Mast/Anchor Maids and Tia/Naga) Blanc teams is usually the most comfortable due to her massive heals and invulnerability.
weaknesses: Demands high skill book and manual resource investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign B / Boss A / PvP SSS based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Bready

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 simply gives an ATK buff, charge speed values are unchanged.

Skill 2 is more important to raise as it holds the base values of her DPS values while providing buffs similar to Skill 1. Level one or two ahead of Skill 1

Burst amplifies Skill 2

characters.summary: One of the harder hitting non-pilgrim DPS’s. She can deal damage in two different ways: distributed damage and sustained damage. Bready does require a strict team to be able to deal any sort of respectable damage. She needs to be paired with Mast: Romantic Maid and Anchor: Innocent Maid or Elegg (copium) for recommended taste status. For Lingering taste status she needs Rosanna: Chic Ocean
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign A / Boss A / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Brid

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 simply increases attack by a modest amount. 

Skill 2 and burst deal pretty solid damage however the inability to control which raptures the skill targets hurts, as well as the MAX HP condition.

characters.summary: Decent DPS and strong damage burst, but it is ST and requires her to be at max HP which can be difficult to maintain in higher level content.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss C / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Brid: Silent Track

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is a nice chunk of Burst Damage when entering Full Burst, and a damage taken debuff to add up with S2. Can be leveled up more if you plan on using her in campaign.

Skill 2 is where the bulk of her personal DPS comes from against bosses, regardless of the team composition she’s used in. While the damage taken debuff on S1 is higher compared to S2’s, both scale poorly with skill levels anyway, so damage is the biggest reason to go for more S2 levels.

Burst provides allies with a very nice caster ATK buff, one of the biggest for a 20s CD unit. It’s honestly such a shame Brid can’t benefit from her own buff, though.

characters.summary: SSR Fire Supporter from Elysion using SG.

characters.name: Centi

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 decreases cooldown of shield, very useful on bosses that hit hard but don’t shoot too many projectiles and kamikaze’s; ineffective against enemies that shoot many projectiles.

Skill 2 serves no purpose as her shield barely has HP, increasing it by a tiny amount will not protect you from more than one shot anyways.

Burst provides a pretty useful defense shred.

characters.summary: Provides Occasional team shields which is useful absorbing single target non-pierce attacks such as chatterbox hits or kamakazi raptures in campaign. Provides strong energy burst generation in PvP and Campaign. Unfortunately does not offer any offensive buffs. Decent pick for Campaign if the team lacks burst energy regeneration.
strengths: Major performance enhancement through Favorite Item activation
weaknesses: Requires dedicated Favorite Item phase investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign C / Boss D / PvP S based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Chime

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 gives Crown a permanent attack buff. It scales with more copies of Chime obtained.

Skill 2 is where a lot of Crown’s DPS comes from. Making all the buffs she receives more efficient for her autoattacking prowess is massive.

Burst provides a huge Attack Damage buff to Crown. However, Crown gives herself a fair amount from S2 and Burst. You can get away with not maxing it, as stacking multiple buffs of the same name dilutes its strength.

characters.summary: SSR Iron Supporter from Pilgrim using SMG.

characters.name: Chisato

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 gives her so much self-buff power. It can be left at 7 since Burst provides the bulk of her personal ATK buff and the B2 can compensate for the lower True Damage self-buff.

Skill 2 has her high scaling True Damage activation. More levels allow it to deal significantly more damage over time.

Burst provides her with a huge self-ATK buff. The ATK buff here scales a bit better than S1's. It can be left at 7 to save on resources.

characters.summary: SSR Iron Attacker from Abnormal using SMG.

characters.name: Cinderella

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is pretty much where all of her non-burst damage resides, upgrade ASAP.

Skill 2 does provide a little HP buff that does improve her ATK, but outside buffers can provide much more for less books, upgrade last

Burst Hurts ALOT, enough said

characters.summary: Best Boss-killer in game currently. Her campaign abilities are a bit lack luster, but still usable in campaign electric weak stages. Cinderella is also a versatile Nikke that can fit in most teams as she doesn't rely on buffers as much.
strengths: High versatility across core raid and progression setups
weaknesses: Demands high skill book and manual resource investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign S / Boss SS / PvP SS based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Cinderella: Crystal Wave

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 contains a damaging effect that activates constantly, every 5 seconds. It’s also the source of one of her buffs.

Skill 2 has a damaging effect like S1, but activates far less frequently, only when she uses her own Burst. While it contains one more buff over S1, buffers can compensate for the slight loss in buff power from an unmaxed S2. Recommended to max eventually, as she is so good.

Burst gives her incredible self-buffing power and has a high damaging effect that scales well.

Skill 1 has very decent cover repair.

Skill 2 is slightly useless as Cocoa does not taunt.

Burst grants a rather modest attack down debuff assuming full stacks of Skill 2.

characters.summary: Average unit, Cleanse too niche to be used generally. Cover repair is alright.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Crow

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 has a modest attack debuff on enemy raptures during full burst.

Burst skill has uncontrollable targeting and also deals mediocre damage.

characters.summary: Her lack of a taunt makes her unable to perform as a tank. The attack debuff alone is not enough to justify taking up a slot.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Crown

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 Offers More DPS gains generally. Extremely powerful when paired with other reload speed Nikkes (Privaty)

Skill 2 offers more utility and self sustainability. It is up to the Commander to choose what to raise first.

Burst is basically just a big DPS buff, with a very nice team shield.

characters.summary: Extremely strong Burst II. Has very Oppressive Offensive buffs with good defensive utility. best Burst II Nikke as of right now.
strengths: Top-tier kit multipliers with irreplacable meta role
weaknesses: Demands high skill book and manual resource investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign SSS / Boss SSS / PvP C based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Crust

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 functions primarely as a utility skill, providing buffs that will be heavily enhanced by her burst

Skill 2 only has a caster ATK buff and Dispel

Burst is where her main power comes from: heavily buffing distributed or sustained damage

characters.summary: Outside of enabling Bready in Tetra tower, Crust should mainly see use if her dispel is necessary for certain content. Outside of that, Crust is outclassed for general use.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign B / Boss B / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: D

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 and 2 mostly affects her personal damage, although skill 1 does it more consistently as it procs on FB and not once per battle unlike skill 2. Skill 2 also increases the stun immunity duration which is not really needed for more than 30s. Leveling skill 2 higher will increase the odds of having 2 burst cycles with extended burst timer, as the burst timer increase proc is linked with skill 2, in which i consider extended Full burst time to be a damage loss.

Burst is a final damage multiplier and the strongest part of her kit.

DONT over invest in skill 2 nor go over 4 because of stated reason above, it will simply gimp overall damage
User may even keep skill 2 at level 1 if desired.

characters.summary: Niche part damage buffer. D provides a good buff against parts however she needs to burst to provide these buffs and her own damage is unimpressive. Parts usually don't have good uptime throughout fights, so most of the time D provides little utility for the team.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: D: Killer Wife

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is rather Niche as it only applies to Pierce Nikkes. Leave at 1 if the Commander simply does not have Pierce Nikkes at hand. Can be leveled up to 10 if desired.

Skill 2 at level 10 ensures very smooth full burst rotations, level Asap if using her as your main CDR Nikke.

Her burst gives rather low values across the board. Since burst mats are extremely valuable, the player can leave this at level 5, and level as needed when having surplus Mats in the future.

characters.summary: Great B1 buffer for Pierce Nikkes, Providing Similar buffing capabilities when compared to Liter, however less flexible. Needs high investment in her skill 2 for her cooldown reduction to be smooth for all teams that have proper burst generation
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign B / Boss A / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Delta
characters.summary: Can only taunt on burst with 40s cooldown. Self defensive buffs are not impactful without a consistent taunt.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Delta: Ninja Thief

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is where a lot of her value comes from as a unit. Damage Taken debuff that activates whether she uses Burst or not is very nice.

Skill 2 improves her self-durability/heal for the team. If using her in a serious campaign setting, you can level it up more for stronger shields.

You should never use her Burst for the foreseeable future. Its gains and values are just so low. The only reason Recommended is set to 4 is because the cost of leveling it to 4 is inconsequential.

characters.summary: SSR Water Defender from Elysion using MG.

characters.name: Diesel

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 needs high investments to work; does good in Arena and tanking when skill is invested enough; assuming Diesel is getting hit by many small damaging bullets rather than single target nukes.

Skill 2 takes too long and too many stacks to be helpful. Taunt duration is tied to her burst level.

characters.summary: Decent against Bowtie and Alteisen. Otherwise a weak taunter with low taunt duration. Interesting self and team ammo buffs, but there are better options,
strengths: Major performance enhancement through Favorite Item activation
weaknesses: Requires dedicated Favorite Item phase investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Diesel: Winter Sweets

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 provides her with an okay critical damage buff, and an important Sustained Damage buff. However, the Sustained Damage buff here pales in comparison to the one from S2, and so is the lower priority one.

Skill 2 not only provides her with massive amounts of Sustained Damage, it is also the source of an additional Sustained Damage DPS debuff against a boss.

Even though Burst appears to have low scaling, after all the Sustained Damage multipliers from S1 and S2 are taken into account, this is one of the hardest hitting bursts in the entire game currently.

characters.summary: SSR Fire Attacker from Elysion using RL.

characters.name: Dolla

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 Modest attack buff basically half the entire fight.

Skill 2’s strength is from cooldown reduction, which is fixed at level 1 to 10, other buffs Skill 2 give is negligible.

Burst is a decent uncontrollable ST nuke.

characters.summary: Dolla is used as a CDR if the Commander does not have any other options. She provides slightly worse CDR reductions than the usual burst I 20s CDR Nikke while providing minor ATK buffs. characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Soldier OW
characters.summary: No real use since N102 is miles better.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Soline

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is broken. Doesn’t give Fire rate at all.

Skill 2 post Soline buff actually gives her a big dps boost when max HP

Burst Additional proc hits 3 times instead of once (max hp), making it a hard hitting burst. Unknown if bug will be fixed anytime soon.

characters.summary: Soline's main gimmick is that she needs to be full hp at all times to be able to deal respectable damage. A lot of her damage comes from her bugged burst, dealing 3x more damage than usual when at full HP. Soline is a viable solo raid DPS if the Commander has multiple elemental rolls on her and needs to be run with a team that is capable of healing or always blocking damage. Her DPS plummets immensely if she's not at 100% Health.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss B / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Soline: Frost Ticket

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is where her cooldown comes from. Should be prioritized ASAP. It’s also where her max HP gain for the team comes from.

Skill 2 is where her healing mechanic comes from when an ally hits critical HP. If planning to use her in PvP, this should be prioritized.

Burst provides a big burst heal. Its value is big, but not worth maxing out if you’re rarely going to use it. PvP should definitely consider leveling it up more.

characters.summary: SSR Water Supporter from Elysion using SG.

characters.name: Sora

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 increases the healing she takes. That's it.

Skill 2 has some overheal and attack buff upon part break which doesn't activate on all bosses.

Burst heals alot and provides a debuff dispell, unfortunately on a 40s cooldown

characters.summary: Sora is definitely one of the most situational Nikkes released in a long while. Her only notable niche is a massive heal, which is rarely useful outside of PvP, and even then, other allies with better burst gen will have to make up for her non-special burst gen.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Sugar

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 required getting hit to get ok buffs.

Skill 2 and Burst synergize well with each other. Higher skill investments would greatly benefit Shotgun teams.

characters.summary: Good Shotgun team buffer. Provides a big boost to ammo capacity for all SG Nikkes in the team. Sugar has respectable DPS due to her burst increasing her firing rate by a large amount. Only use against bosses/large targets as bullet spread on shotguns are terrible for hitting small target/mobs. Replaces Privaty: Unkind Maid in SG teams in iron weak content.
strengths: Major performance enhancement through Favorite Item activation
weaknesses: Requires dedicated Favorite Item phase investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss C / PvP B based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Takina

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 contains an ATK buff that does little for Takina due to its short duration, and a nice True Damage buff that is completely superceded by her S2 True Damage buff.

Skill 2’s True Damage buff is ridiculous. The Damage Taken debuff going up is a nice little bonus. It is what really sets apart her buff compared to other B2 units.

Burst gives her strong DPS capabilities. While it can be left at 7 to save on materials, it is recommended to get it to 10 when it is most opportune, to boost her overall DPS in bossing content.

characters.summary: SSR Iron Supporter from Abnormal using SR.

characters.name: Tia

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 Is the meat of her offensive support capabilities. Extremely good buff, level asap for solo raid and union raid usage.

Skill 2 Improves her cover survivability, but usually this won’t be an issue as she provides enough at low levels.

Burst simply gives shields, no investment really needed.

characters.summary: Should always be paired with Naga. Provides strong attack damage buffs and full team shields every burst. Despite Crown simply being better and can be paired with Naga, Tia is still important in content that requires multiple teams (Solo Raid/Union Raid).
weaknesses: Demands high skill book and manual resource investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign B / Boss A / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Tove

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 Gives more consistency towards her stack gain and gives more ammo. One can stop at level 6 as she’s not a meta defining character as of right now. But it is recommended to level up this skill to level 9 for stacking consistency

Skill 2 gives more attack speed and skill level 6 is a breakthrough on increased ATK spd. Anymore than level 6 is not worth the skill books.

Burst provides a simple yet big ATK buff for shotgun Nikkes.

characters.summary: Very strong shotgun Team Buffer, and Tove's team archetype is still a staple Solo raid team 5 for most bosses. Tove is mostly held back by "just good" shotgun nikkes currently. Assume boss rating is based on her best in slot team, otherwise assume A tier in bossing. Tove's skill 1 is required to be at least skill 9 to ensure somewhat consistent stacking in boss battles without the help of outside buffers. Tove's skill 2 and burst is also extremely important for overall DPS in shotgun teams
strengths: Major performance enhancement through Favorite Item activation
weaknesses: Requires dedicated Favorite Item phase investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss S / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Trina

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is basically just healing, upgrade if more sustain is needed in boss battles

Skill 2 hyper buffs an electric assault rifle Nikkes by a massive amount (Currently only Scarlet) while also providing PvP utility

Burst buffs AoE “Affects all Nikke” bursts by a massive amount. Important for all game modes.

characters.summary: Good universal supporter, a great electric (rifle) buffer and an amazing nuke buffer. Has a lot of potential to be one of the meta buffers when we get more viable electric rifle buffers as currently we only have Scarlet (PvP/PvE) and Moran (PvP) as our notable electric Assault rifle units.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign A / Boss A / PvP SSS based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Trony

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 and Skill 2 reduces the amount of full charge shoots during full burst cycles when spamming shots on manual.

Burst is where most of her damage will come from, needs rather heavy investment for her to deal respectable damage

characters.summary: Manually intensive for almost no reward. Slightly above average DPS in boss battles, mediocre in pvp and campaign. used in solo raid if Trony has enough elemental damage rolls.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss C / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Velvet

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 shouldn't be leveled outside of if using Maxwell to buff Velvet's Burst DPS, to try to secure her ATK buff. The buff itself lasts too little to be impactful to her general DPS, hence its low priority.

Skill 2 is her most important skill. It is where her big charge damage buff is for allies when played off-burst, and where her damage activation is when she uses her burst. Very high priority.

Burst is honestly quite strong, however, it only benefits her if being used as a DPS unit. Can be left at a low level until needed to deal DPS in Wind Raids.

characters.summary: SSR Wind Supporter from Tetra using SR.

characters.name: Vesti

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 simply increases explosion radius.

Skill 2 does increase crit damage and crit rate modestly, but the ATK buff is miniscule.

Burst simply takes too long to stack to be useful in stages but still does okay.

characters.summary: Lowers full burst duration, allowing for faster rotations with CDR. Notable for having high splash radius (can hit many boss parts if they are close to eachother, like chatterbox, thermite etc)
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1’s charge speed doesn’t increase with level. All that goes up is the charge damage boost for Vesti’s weak rockets.

Skill 2 is where so much of her damage comes from. True damage proc per rocket and buffs from being with her allies.

Burst increases her personal True Damage buff, and strenghtens the power of the screenwipe.

characters.summary: SSR Fire Attacker from Elysion using RL.

characters.name: Viper

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 is slightly useful in campaign, but uses are simply too limited in a fight to be investing at high levels.

Burst deals decent ST nuke with good defense shred.

characters.summary: Decent b2 Offensive option, Competes against guilty regarding utility via better burst gen, but weaker personal damage.
strengths: Major performance enhancement through Favorite Item activation
weaknesses: Requires dedicated Favorite Item phase investment
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP B based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Volume

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 simply never procs and the attack buff affects her minimally anyway.

Skill 2 buffs are not good and CDR is fixed on skill level 1.

Burst is decent for crit focused teams such as Julia and Maiden.

characters.summary: Provides CDR and crit buffs for the team. Unfortunately Crit buffs are miniscule DPS buffs due to how the damage formula works, she's mostly used in solo raids simply because she provides consistent cool down reduction. outclassed by almost all other Burst I Cooldown reduction options. She does well with the Maid Duo due to the synergy of Crit Buffs.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign A / Boss A / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Yan

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 works okay only in RL teams, which are used against Obelisk in Union Raid.

Burst is used for relocating raptures which is fixed; not for her damage.

characters.summary: Decent charge buffer, but Liter is better. Unique enemy grouping CC.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Yukiko

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 contains her substantial heal, a great ATK buff that is effectively permanent, and is the source of the Distributed Damage she can perform that scales properly.

Skill 2 does the most for her offensively; a massive Elemental Damage and Attack Damage buff, a Distributed Damage buff that empowers her S1, and a massive ATK buff to provide for Makoto (or another Yukiko in Co-Op). S2 is also the source of her greater heals when Burst is active.

Burst's damage is only okay because it doesn't benefit from 'entering Full Burst' buffs. The ATK it provides is the main benefit, which she gets plenty of from S1, Makoto when they're paired up, and buffers she'll likely pair up with will likely still have ATK buffs, making the ATK buff from Burst less needed.

characters.summary: Has a decent heal that is active at all times, and becomes stronger when she uses Burst, giving her good utility. Thanks to having a better general weapon, she can fit in more teams compared to Makoto; is the main DPS of the team when paired with Makoto. Her wave clear is only okay, despite having Distributed Damage, as it only activates when she uses her own Burst. Due to how much ATK she gives herself, even without Queen (Makoto), she loves Attack Damage buffers and Damage Taken debuffs the most.
strengths: High versatility across core raid and progression setups
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign A / Boss SS / PvP C based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Yulha

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 has a horrible condition to proc, getting hit 30 times.

Skill 2 is great for SW and MX teams with proper timing.

characters.summary: The strongest attack buff in the game, but can be difficult to utilize around her 30s cooldown.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss C / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Yuni

skillInvestment.notes: Skill 1 maybe be useful in RL based teams.

characters.summary: Yuni is mostly used as a charge speed buffer for Alice if she doesn't meet the required 100%~ charge speed she needs to instantly charge her shots. Her lifesteal buff is miniscule and can't fully sustain a team by itself.
characters.whyThisTier: Current Nikke.gg evaluation places this unit at Campaign D / Boss D / PvP D based on kit scaling and content synergy.

characters.name: Zwei

skillInvestment.notes:
Skill 1 Is strong when paired with Maxwell/Snow white, as their bursts are massive, one shot hits. Less effective with Alice and Red hood due to the limit of one of the buffs only lasting a hit.

Skill 2 can be upgraded as needed for survivability.

Burst mats are scarce, so only upgrade beyond 7 if needed, the values are not high enough to warrant spending gold books.

characters.summary: Works good in her niche pierce teams, however still outshadowed by the top tier burst II supports even in pierce teams. Pairs better with Snow white and Maxwell.
strengths: Major performance enhancement through Favorite Item activation
weaknesses: Requires dedicated Favorite Item phase investment

campaign.description: 评估单位在主线剧情推进、高Combat Power赤字（越战）、部落之塔及常驻PvE关卡中的实战表现。
criteria: CP Deficit Performance (战力惩罚下的生存与输出耐受力)
Mob Clearing (清杂群怪效率与大范围扫射能力)
Burst Chain Flexibility (连携循环平滑度与CD周转自理能力)
Survivability & Sustain (全队护盾、掩体修复与容错庇护)

boss.description: 评估单位在拦截战（Interception EX/Anomaly）、联合突袭（Union Raid）及单人突袭（Solo Raid）中的输出与辅助贡献。
criteria: Single Target / Parts Damage (单体与多部位极限爆发伤害)
Sustained DPS (技能循环周期内的稳定输出与暖机时间)
Core & Vulnerability Multipliers (核心穿透增伤与团队独立乘区增益)
Elemental Adaptability (元素克制破盾与特定首领机制应对)

pvp.description: 评估单位在新人竞技场（Rookie Arena）与特殊竞技场（Special Arena）中的胜率与战术价值。
criteria: Burst Generation Speed (普通攻击蓄力充能效率与先手大招速度)

Damage Share & Stall (分摊伤害、不屈锁血与全队无敌生存机制)
Counter & Taunt Utility (受击反伤、全屏挑衅与特定武器克制)
